protocols.title: Stock camera internal Expert versus exported widget route isolation
protocols.objective: Determine whether internal Expert lens selection produces distinct optical routes while an adjacent exported widget focal-launch mechanism remains isolated as a negative control.
protocols.scope: Nothing A001 / Galaga stock camera builds linked through the firmware version matrix. The protocol distinguishes tested launch mechanisms and does not generalize a failure from one route to all stock-camera paths.

scene.description: Static high-detail scene containing near, mid-distance and distant geometry with visible edge alignment across the frame.
scene.subject: Fixed textured target and distant background suitable for field-of-view comparison.
scene.background: Distant straight-line geometry extending to the frame edges.

lighting.measurementMethod: Record a calibrated lux-meter reading at the subject before the first capture and after the final capture.

motion.camera: Tripod-fixed; stabilization settled before every launch and capture.
motion.subject: Static throughout the complete positive and negative control sequence.

deviceState.orientation: Landscape, fixed orientation for all captures.
deviceState.thermalState: Start below moderate thermal throttling and record the observed thermal status.
deviceState.networkState: Airplane mode unless the tested launch mechanism requires another state; record any exception.
other: Disable automatic display rotation after fixing orientation.
Clear the stock camera from recents before each isolated launch path.
Do not change the scene, tripod position or lighting between controls.

launchProcedure.action: Record the matrix build ID, stock camera package version, process identity, permissions, AppOps, tool versions and UTC experiment-start timestamp.
launchProcedure.expectedObservation: All required build and identity fields are populated before camera launch.

launchProcedure.action: Force-stop the stock camera, launch it through the normal application entry point and enter Expert mode without restoring an old task.
launchProcedure.expectedObservation: A fresh stock camera process reaches Expert mode and reports the selected focal preset.

launchProcedure.action: After the internal Expert sequence, force-stop the stock camera and invoke the exported widget focal-launch path in a fresh process for the negative control.
launchProcedure.expectedObservation: The exported path is isolated from the prior Expert task and its launch parameters are recorded.

captureOrder.action: Capture the internal Expert 1x / 24 mm route.
captureOrder.expectedObservation: The main-route positive control reports approximately 5.56 mm physical and 24 mm equivalent focal length.

captureOrder.action: Capture the internal Expert 0.6x / 15 mm route.
captureOrder.expectedObservation: The route is optically distinct from the 24 mm main positive control and reports approximately 1.64 mm physical / 15 mm equivalent focal length.

captureOrder.action: Capture the internal Expert 2x / 50 mm route.
captureOrder.expectedObservation: The route is optically distinct from the 24 mm main positive control and reports approximately 7.10 mm physical / 50 mm equivalent focal length.

captureOrder.action: Invoke exported widget focal-launch values 15 mm, 24 mm and 50 mm in fresh stock camera processes and capture the resulting route metadata.
captureOrder.expectedObservation: The negative-control mechanism is evaluated independently; any unchanged route is scoped to the exported widget path only.

positive.rationale: Confirms that the stock camera, metadata collection and capture association are functioning on the tested build.
positive.expectedObservation: 5.56 mm physical focal length and 24 mm equivalent geometry are associated with the captured image.
positive.failureInterpretation: The experiment is inconclusive because the known main route or artifact association was not reproduced under the tested state.

positive.rationale: Provides a within-application positive control for three optically distinct field-of-view outputs.
positive.expectedObservation: 15 mm, 24 mm and 50 mm equivalent outputs with distinct physical focal lengths and no digital crop masquerading as the route change.
positive.failureInterpretation: Internal Expert route distinction was not reproduced under the tested build, identity, state and parameters.

negative.mechanism: Fresh-process exported widget focal-launch values 15 mm, 24 mm and 50 mm.
negative.rationale: Tests an adjacent external entry point so its behavior is not conflated with internal Expert routing.
negative.expectedObservation: The mechanism either produces independently verified route changes or remains on one route; both outcomes are scoped to this exported path.
negative.failureInterpretation: Exported widget focal routing failed under the exact tested build, identity, launch state and focal parameters; this does not disprove internal Expert or other privileged routes.

timing.clockSource: Host/device clocks synchronized before collection; record both when available.

passCriteria: The positive controls complete with associated images, results and expected main-route metadata.
Internal Expert 15 mm, 24 mm and 50 mm captures show distinct physical focal lengths and field of view.
The exported widget route is reported separately with its exact observed behavior and no cross-path generalization.
inconclusiveCriteria: The positive main-route control fails or images cannot be associated with capture results.
Build, package, identity, timing or artifact hashes are missing.
Scene, camera position or lighting changes materially between controls.
A restored task prevents fresh-process launch-path isolation.
interpretation.negativeResultTemplate: <mechanism> failed under <build, identity, state and parameters>
prohibitedGeneralizations: The sensor route does not exist.
No privileged or internal mechanism can work.
confidenceUpgradeRequirements: Repeat the complete sequence on at least two fresh processes under the same immutable build entry.
Correlate every image with capture result focal length and route metadata.
Trace the selected endpoint or downstream route for C4 confirmation.

safety.deviceRisk: Read-only observation and ordinary stock-camera operation; do not change permissions, SELinux policy or firmware.
safety.dataHandling: Keep raw images, traces and diagnostic JSON in the operator-controlled artifact store; commit only hashes, metadata and derived records.
stopConditions: Stop if the device exceeds the chosen thermal limit.
Stop if capture association becomes ambiguous or raw artifacts cannot be hashed.
Stop before any step would require bypassing package authorization or changing device security policy.
